adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents` was changed to `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and, when a matching credential isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } ... })` inside that loop. This creates an N+1 query pattern and runs sequentially per destination calendar instead of batching (e.g., collecting credentialIds and using a single `findMany`), which is a concrete performance/architecture concern introduced by the diff, not a direct correctness defect.
